informal: The Lean builds one logspace-computable deterministic estimator \(f\) within \(1/32\) of the normalized estimator value on every sampling environment, and shows that its conditional average at the start is within \(1/8\) of \(p_{\mathcal M}(x)\).

results.informal: There is a uniformly logspace-computable \(f\) whose normalized output is within \(1/32\) of the estimator value \(\bar W(z)\) on every environment, and then the conditional average of the outputs over environments with \(X_f(z)=1\) is within \(1/8\) of \(p_{\mathcal M}(x)\).
results.note: Lean proves only a fixed constant accuracy (\(1/8\) for the conditional average) sufficient for bounded-error decisions, rather than accuracy \((n+2)^{-d}\) for every fixed \(d\).

decls.name: fixed_precision_estimator
decls.informal: For admissible constants with \(B\ge6\) and error budget \(\le2^{B}\), and a machine with the logarithmic space bound, there is a uniformly logspace-computable \(f\) with \(|\min(64,f(x,s))/64-\bar W_s(z)|\le1/32\) for every input \(x\) and every sampling environment \(s\).

chunks.Equality.fixed_precision_estimator/0: Obtain the finite estimator program \(p\) with its instruction parameters \(v\) and level \(k\), meeting the resource contracts for precision exponent \(6\).
chunks.Equality.fixed_precision_estimator/1: These data, together with the admissibility of every input under \(B\ge6\) and error budget \(\le2^{B}\), satisfy the sanity conditions of the estimator.
chunks.Equality.fixed_precision_estimator/2: Sane estimator data under the logarithmic space bound yield a uniformly logspace-computable \(f\) with \(|\min(64,f(x,s))/64-\bar W_s(z)|\le1/32\) for all \(x\) and \(s\).

decls.name: probes
decls.informal: If \(|f(s)-\bar W_s(z)|\le1/32\) for every environment \(s\) with \(X_f(z)=1\), then \(|p_{\mathcal M}(x)-\mathbb E[f\mid X_f(z)=1]|<1/8\).

chunks.ProbabilityDecision.probes/0: Replace \(p_{\mathcal M}(x)\) by the true value \(p_0(x_0)\) at the start vertex.
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.probes/1: \(|p_0(x_0)-W(z)|\le1/32\) for the deterministic hierarchy value \(W(z)\), and \(|W(z)-\mathbb E[\bar W(z)\mid X_f(z)=1]|\le1/32\).
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.probes/2: Averaging the hypothesis gives \(|\mathbb E[f\mid X_f(z)=1]-\mathbb E[\bar W(z)\mid X_f(z)=1]|\le1/32\).
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.probes/3: Adding the three errors gives \(|p_0(x_0)-\mathbb E[f\mid X_f(z)=1]|\le3/32<1/8\).

results.informal: For every environment-indexed vector \(F\), \(|\mathbb E[F(z)\mid X_f(z)=1]|\le N\|F\|_4\), and hence \(|W(z)-\mathbb E[\bar W(z)\mid X_f(z)=1]|\le1/32\).
results.note: Like the paper, Lean keeps only the summand at the specified start and pays a factor \(N\), but it bounds the conditional mean via the fourth-moment integrated norm instead of an eighth-moment Markov tail bound.

decls.name: designate
decls.informal: For every environment-indexed vector \(F\), \(|\mathbb E[F(z)\mid X_f(z)=1]|\le N\|F\|_4\), where \(\|F\|_4\) is the integrated fourth-root norm at the top stage.

chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate/0: Write \(\pi\) for the selection probability, \(N\) for the stage size, \(z\) for the start child, and \(k=\mathbb E[F(z)\mid X_f(z)=1]\).
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate/1: The rate exponent of the top stage is \(B\).
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate/2: \(2^{B}\le n\), the size of the prime field.
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate/2/2: The field-size bound of the setup applies because \(B\) is below the ceiling.
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate/3: \(z\) is a vertex of the top stage.
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate/6: Every conditional fourth moment \(\mathbb E[F(i)^4\mid X_f(i)=1]\) is nonnegative.
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate/8: The nominal rate is at most \(\pi\).
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate/9: Let \(u=(N\cdot 2^{-HB})^{-1}\) be the normalization of the integrated norm.
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate/10: \(u\,\pi\,k^4\le\|F\|_4^4\), by keeping only the nonnegative summand at \(z\) in \(\|F\|_4^4=u\sum_i\pi\,\mathbb E[F(i)^4\mid X_f(i)=1]\).
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate/17: Chain \(k^4\le N\cdot u\pi k^4\le N\|F\|_4^4\le N^4\|F\|_4^4\).

decls.name: designate_est
decls.informal: \(|W(z)-\mathbb E[\bar W(z)\mid X_f(z)=1]|\le1/32\), where \(W\) is the deterministic hierarchy value and \(\bar W\) the estimator value.

chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate_est/1: The integrated error estimate holds for the estimator at the top budget.
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate_est/2: In particular \(\|\bar W-W\|_4\) is at most the allowed error at the top level.
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate_est/3: Let \(F=W-\bar W\) as an environment-indexed vector.
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate_est/4: Apply the single-vertex bound to \(F\): \(|\mathbb E[F(z)\mid X_f(z)=1]|\le N\|F\|_4\).
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate_est/5: The conditional mean of the difference is the difference of conditional means.
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate_est/6: The conditional mean of the deterministic \(W\) is \(W\) itself.
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate_est/7: So it suffices to bound \(N\|W-\bar W\|_4\le1/32\).
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate_est/9: The allowance equals \(\delta(D)\,\delta(B)^2\), where \(D\) is the density exponent.
chunks.ProbabilityDecision.designate_est/12/1: Multiply out to get the identity.
